script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'kev-wave-b',
  description: 'Kev data factory wave B: incident and synth groups per JUDGE-BUILD-PLAN.json (bed audits now complete: incident 4.2.0, synth 3.0.0), each built then adversarially reviewed and fixed',
  phases: [{ title: 'Build' }, { title: 'Review' }],
}
const RULES = "Repository: /home/user/workflow-foundry. AGENTS.md rules apply. Do NOT commit, push or touch git state. You are building part of the Kev judge data factory: program research/kev-20261007/JUDGE-PROGRAM.md (revision 2; weak model = Haiku 5.5, claude-haiku-5-5, owner decision O1), build plan research/kev-20261007/JUDGE-BUILD-PLAN.json, shared contracts and library already built and reviewed in experiments/kev-data/ (read experiments/kev-data/README.md first; tests: node --test experiments/kev-data/test/*.test.mjs).
HARD BOUNDARIES:
- NEVER write under src/, web/, bin/, schemas/, policy/, skills/ (they form the frozen construction kit of the running C0/P1 experiments; any new file there invalidates them). The plan's outputs named src/judges/<x>.mjs are RELOCATED to experiments/kev-data/judges/<x>.mjs until P1 finishes; import the kit from experiments/kev-data/judges/kit.mjs.
- Do not edit beds/ (bed audits are complete: incident is 4.2.0 with new tags rival and blip-rival, synth is 3.0.0; read them only through the frozen-copy API), experiments/c0, experiments/p1, experiments/lib, experiments/workflows, bridge/, tools/, research/ except your group's own files listed in the plan under experiments/kev-data/ and research/kev-20261007/data/ if the plan names them.
- Import beds ONLY through the frozen copy API in lib/pin.mjs (never the live beds/ tree), never list/hash/open beds/sealed/, never inspect test-split contents (seeds >= 5000) yourself: code may generate test slices per the split table, you report only counts and hashes.
- Labels come only from generator truth, simulators, oracles, replays or journals; NEVER from an LLM. Held-out wordings and templates never enter train slices.
- Node >= 24, ESM, node:test, no new npm dependencies; Python only via /opt/kev-venv/bin/python -I (Kev checkout /home/user/jaredpalmer/kev at 5e42a7a; HF cache /opt/hf-cache offline).
- Build outputs (datasets) go under .foundry/kev-data/ (git-ignored) per the plan; only code, specs, manifests and small summaries go in git paths.
- Other groups are being built in parallel by other agents: touch only your group's files; if you need a shared-library change, implement it minimally, keep all existing kev-data tests green, and report it explicitly."
const run = await pipeline(["incident", "synth"],
  g => agent(`${RULES}

YOUR GROUP: "${g}". Read its entry in research/kev-20261007/JUDGE-BUILD-PLAN.json (scope, outputs, acceptanceTests, estimatedRecords, cutLine) and the program sections it cites. TASK (build): implement the group completely, meeting every acceptance test (as node:test tests in its test file), using the contracts-lib APIs (experiments/kev-data/README.md). Run the group's tests and the contracts-lib tests (node --test experiments/kev-data/test/*.test.mjs). Report: files written, each acceptance test pass/fail/deferred-under-cutLine with reason, measured record counts per slice, surface-diversity numbers, and every spec ambiguity you resolved.`, { label: `build:${g}`, phase: 'Build', model: 'sonnet', effort: 'xhigh' }),
  (rep, g) => agent(`${RULES}

YOUR GROUP: "${g}" (entry in research/kev-20261007/JUDGE-BUILD-PLAN.json). TASK (adversarial review, then fix): another agent built this group (report below). Verify every acceptance test truly holds (seed defects and confirm the tests fail), hunt for label leakage and shortcuts (bag-of-words probe via lib/probe.mjs on train vs held-out slices; partial-input baselines; held-out wording/template leaks into train; reserved worlds; test-split seeds used only for test slices and never inspected), check labels come only from generator truth/simulators/oracles/replays (never an LLM), that the program's decidability audit (§2.7) is implemented, and that nothing was written under src/ or other frozen paths. Then FIX every P0/P1 defect yourself (edit only this group's outputs and its test file), re-run all kev-data tests, and return: defects found (P0/P1/P2) with what you fixed, final acceptance status, and open items.

BUILD REPORT:
${rep}`, { label: `review:${g}`, phase: 'Review', model: 'opus', effort: 'xhigh' }).then(r => ({ group: g, build: rep, review: r })),
)
return run
